# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.6 Module 3: Civilization Regencies, Heir Educations & Designated Heir Reasons (oe_reg_). Generated by gen_v96_regency_edu.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Scope for potential / allow / on_education_start_effect is the Character being educated.
# Zero collision with existing oe_byz_royal_education.txt or vanilla child_educations.

oe_edu_byz_porphyrogenitus = {
	potential = {
		owner = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = BYZ
				has_or_had_tag = ROM
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		OR = {
			is_heir = yes
			AND = {
				has_dynasty = yes
				owner = {
					exists = ruler_or_regent
					ruler_or_regent = { has_dynasty = yes }
				}
				dynasty = owner.ruler_or_regent.dynasty
			}
		}
	}
	price_to_select = oe_reg_select_edu_porphyrogenitus
	price_to_deselect = oe_reg_deselect_edu_porphyrogenitus
	modifier = {
		character_child_education_modifier = 0.75
		character_adm_child_education_modifier = 0.65
		character_dip_child_education_modifier = 0.55
	}
	country_modifier = {
		court_spending_efficiency = -0.04
		cultural_tradition_modifier = 0.02
	}
	on_education_start_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				religion != owner.religion
				religion.group = religion_group:christian
				owner = { religion.group = religion_group:christian }
			}
			change_character_religion = owner.religion
		}
	}
}
